ev.q: Ninety-one interviews were completed in Montura Ranch Estates (overall response rate: 55%) and 74 in Pioneer Plantation
In Montura Ranch Estates, 74 (81%) households lived in mobile homes, and 17 (19%) lived in single-family homes
Eighty-two (90%) households in Montura Ranch Estates
A total of 145 of 150 (97%) households in both communities reported having access to a 3-day supply of food
Only 5% of survey participants had a working CO detector in their homes
Eighty-two (90%) households in Montura Ranch Estates and 58 ( 80%) in Pioneer Plantation reported receiving disaster relief
